analysis.summary: The PR introduces a syntax error in imports and misuses the Urql client API, which will cause build failures and runtime logic errors where translation data is lost.

bugs.title: Syntax error in imports
bugs.description: A comma is missing between 'GetTranslationsByPathQuery' and 'GetTranslationsByPathQueryVariables' in the import statement.
bugs.risk: This is a syntax error that will prevent the package from compiling or transpiling, leading to immediate build failure.

bugs.title: Urql query missing .toPromise()
bugs.description: The Urql client.query() method returns a Source (observable-like), but it is being awaited without calling .toPromise(). This is inconsistent with other query calls in the same file (e.g., line 85).
bugs.risk: Since 'await source' does not behave like 'await promise', the variables 'translationsAEM' and 'translationsError' will be undefined. This causes the translation merging logic to fail silently, resulting in a website missing critical feature-app translations.

notBugs.reason: The use of intersection type (Query1 & Query2) is correct because the objects are merged via Object.assign before being passed to the function.
The @ts-expect-error on line 101 is used intentionally to handle a fallback case where the translation field was removed from the primary query type but is manually added as a default value.
